ext.description: Simple visual Git inside VS Code: standardized commits, sync, rebase/merge and history, without typing commands.
cmd.guide: Quick Git: Open getting started guide
cmd.stageFile: Quick Git: Stage file for commit
cfg.title: Quick Git Commit
cfg.language: Interface language. "auto" follows the VS Code language (Portuguese or English).
cfg.commitTypes: Commit prefixes. Each item is a text ("feat") or an object { "label": "perf", "description": "Performance" }.
cfg.messageMaxLength: Maximum characters of the commit message (without the prefix). Use 0 for no limit.
cfg.askBranch: In the quick commit, ask whether to keep, switch or create a branch.
cfg.defaultAction: What to do after writing the message. "ask" shows the options.
cfg.checkForUpdates: Once a day, checks GitHub for a newer release and shows a notice with a download button. Nothing is installed automatically. Turn off if you install from a marketplace that updates the extension for you.
